issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavior break mislabeled as a fix.
issues.detail: Changing the default alters endpointing for every caller who took the default. The changelog files it under 'fixed' but this is a behavioral default change. Update the changelog to call it a breaking default change, document the migration path in the docstring, and clarify what FIXED vs EXTERNAL now mean since both can read as 'Pipecat-controlled'.

issues.description: _enable_vad membership check uses a list literal and lacks a stated invariant; verify EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is imported.
issues.detail: The `in [FIXED, EXTERNAL]` check should be a tuple or frozenset to signal an immutable membership test. The predicate's name now diverges from its semantics ('emits VAD frames') and needs a one-line invariant comment. Also confirm EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED exists in the installed SDK or construction will raise AttributeError.

issues.description: split_sentences is plumbed as Optional[bool] then coerced with `or False`; double-written through generic loop and dedicated assignment.
issues.detail: Declare `split_sentences: bool = False` instead of the tri-state Optional, drop the `or False` coercion, and remove the duplicate write (it appears both in the generic keys loop and in a dedicated `SpeechSegmentConfig` assignment). Pick one shape and one write path.

issues.description: Commented-out `start_processing_metrics()` call was moved rather than deleted or uncommented.
issues.detail: The `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was relocated within `_handle_start_of_turn` with no functional effect. Either uncomment it with a rationale or delete it; git remembers. Carrying dead code forward in a new position implies undocumented intent.

issues.description: Frame-handler swap to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame lacks a rationale comment and may be unreachable when internal VAD is enabled.
issues.detail: The change is correct under the new model but readers must infer it from the frame name. Add a one-line comment explaining that finalization is driven by VAD-origin stop frames so fixed/external modes don't double-finalize. Consider subscribing only when `not self._enable_vad` and dropping the warn-and-no-op branch.

issues.description: Patch bundles three logically independent changes that should land as separate diffs.
issues.detail: The PR combines (1) the VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame switch, (2) the FIXED enum addition and default flip, and (3) the split_sentences feature. Each is independently reviewable and revertable; bundling makes future bisects painful. Split into three commits or PRs.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The headline concern is the silent default flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED, mislabeled as a fix rather than a breaking default change. Secondary structural concerns are an under-documented `_enable_vad` predicate using the wrong data shape for membership, a tri-state Optional[bool] for what is plainly a boolean (with a duplicate write path), and a relocated commented-out metrics call that should be deleted or uncommented. Torvalds also flags scope: the diff bundles three independent changes and should be split for bisectability.
